The Web UI is the same interface as the desktop app, served by the gateway itself.
The Web UI has its own login and password, separate from the seller account:
a random password generated on the first start;

After the Web UI login, sign in to the seller account as usual if the gateway is not logged in yet.
The seller session is shared: a browser reload or a gateway restart keeps it.

Repeated wrong passwords slow further attempts from that address down (up to 5 minutes). Web UI
sessions live in memory: a gateway restart asks to sign in again.
The desktop app can serve the Web UI too:

, with its port, path
and credentials. It listens on
unless you set another bind address.

The safest way to reach a gateway on another machine is an SSH tunnel — nothing is exposed to the
network:
language-bash shiki shiki-themes material-theme-lighter material-theme material-theme-palenight
